newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche Telekom closes 5 percent lower.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Telekom closes 5 percent lower.

text.p: German telecommunications giant Deutsche Telekom's stock lost more than 5 percent Tuesday as investors took profits a day after the shares began trading in Europe's biggest initial public offering.
Telekom lost 1.83 marks ($1.21) to close at 32.07 ($21.35), near the day's low of 31.95 ($21.26) but still well above the issue price of 28.50 marks ($18.96).

Dealers said there had been strong demand Monday from institutional investors, who had not received as many shares as they would have liked in the heavily oversubscribed IPO, but investors were now taking profits.
Deutsche Telekom's American depositary shares, which trade on the New York Stock Exchange, lcosed Monday at $21.50.
